title: Quartz
description: A powerful, open-source job scheduling library for .NET.

data.text: Quartz.NET is a powerful, open-source job scheduling library for .NET. It supports complex scheduling requirements including cron-like expressions, calendars, and job persistence.

data.title: Creating a Scheduled Job
data.content: Define and schedule a job with Quartz.

terms.definition: The interface that all Quartz jobs must implement.
Defines when a job should execute (e.g., cron, interval).

data.title: Integration
data.text: Quartz integrates well with ASP.NET Core and supports persistent job stores (e.g., SQL Server).

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Quartz is ideal for complex scheduling requirements in .NET.

data.title: Exercise
data.description: Create a Quartz job that runs every minute.
data.expectedOutcome: A job executing on a schedule using Quartz.
